collection_caveats: Coverage is relative to the currently published source lists; 2026 proceedings may still change.
TCC 2026 includes 69 papers from the official accepted-paper list before DBLP has indexed those proceedings.
CryptoDB was inaccessible during this expansion; publisher metadata and abstracts supplemented conference rosters, with OpenAlex enrichment where available.
Missing abstracts are recorded explicitly. A listed paper is not evidence that its abstract has been obtained.
SIGMOD uses verified conference-specific PACMMOD issues from 2023 onward; PODS issues and companion proceedings are excluded.
SIGMOD 2024 includes DOI 10.1145/3626738 from the official OpenTOC although DBLP omits it. The official 2025 OpenTOCs omit issue 2(4); the full roster is supplemented by DBLP.

PVLDB is grouped by article publication year, not conference presentation year. Official volume verification depends on DBLP year metadata; volumes span calendar years and conference presentations can roll over.
PVLDB has 76 missing abstracts; 74 of these records have no DOI in DBLP and the older official volume pages do not expose abstracts. Their titles and paper links remain in the collection.

ICDE excludes the 2025 chairs message. The confirmed Crossref DOI alias 10.1109/icde55515.2023.00384 is linked to canonical DOI 10.1109/icde55515.2023.00388, retaining both DBLP source identifiers as one paper.
